verdict: Lead volume is solid at 642 this period, but cost per lead has crept above benchmark on the latest day.
diagnosis: Instagram campaign drove 642 leads on $13,625 spend, averaging $21 per lead — below legal norms, but latest-day cost per lead jumped to $20.63.

signals.headline: 642 leads from $13,625 spend

signals.headline: Cost per lead rose to $20.63
signals.detail: Latest-day cost per lead sits above the 28-day average of $13.05. Watch for creative fatigue on Video Ad 04.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: <cite index="1-4">The 2026 attorneys and legal services benchmark for average cost per lead is $131.63</cite>. Your $21 average this period sits far below that, suggesting efficient targeting — or leads that need qualification.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Bilingual demand is rising in legal
seasonal.body: <cite index="18-13">Bilingual marketing is flagged as a 2026 growth area for law firms</cite>. Your Spanish-language search traffic (consumer protection queries) supports testing Spanish ad creative.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="19-6">67% of prospective clients hire whichever firm responds first</cite>. With 264 call clicks this period, intake speed likely matters more than ad spend adjustments.

recommendations.title: Refresh Video Ad 04 before cost per lead climbs further
recommendations.detail: Latest-day cost per lead hit $20.63 versus $13 average. Consider testing a new hook or second creative variant to counter fatigue on the top-performing ad.

recommendations.title: Test a Spanish-language version of your top ad
recommendations.detail: Organic traffic shows Spanish consumer-protection searches reaching your site. Worth exploring a translated Video Ad 04 to capture an underserved segment cheaply.

recommendations.title: Audit intake speed on the 264 call clicks
recommendations.detail: Phone intent is strong this period. Confirm every call is answered live within 60 seconds — missed calls are the biggest hidden leak for law firms.
